svg.title: Two controls, two different effects
svg.desc: Two controlled line plots use seed 42 and the x-axis slice y=z=0. Left: frequency 0.65 versus 1.6 at amplitude 1. Right: amplitude 0.5 versus 1.5 at frequency 0.9. Both cover x in [−3,3] and scaled value in [−0.6,0.6]. Scaled value is amplitude times the app’s Gradient scalar value; amplitude is applied outside createFields.scalar. Shape-specific geometric rendering factors are omitted; terrain applies an additional factor of 1.65.

g.text: A one-dimensional slice separates coordinate scaling from output scaling.
Scaled value = A × 1.55 × noise(f x, 0, 0) · Seed 42 · Same x and output scales
Amplitude acts after sampling; the zero crossings stay in exactly the same places
Shape-specific render factors are omitted; terrain adds another ×1.65
